card.name: Words just before an expected "the/an"
card.fires_on: Words in ALL-CAPS warning text that sit right before a small article or determiner such as "an" or "the". Often they are linking words, or pieces of longer words, where the next word is likely "an" or "the".

modes.label: Linking words before an article
modes.description: Short verbs, prepositions or adjectives in capitalised label text that are followed by "an" or "the".
modes.example: THERE APPEARS TO<< BE>> AN INCREASED RISK OF DEVELO

modes.label: Partway through long capitalised words
modes.description: Word pieces inside capitalised medical terms, before the word ends or the next word starts.
modes.example: XICITY OF POLYMYXIN B SULFATE CAN RESULT IN RESPIRATORY PARALYSIS FROM NEUROMUSC<<ULAR>> BLOCKADE, ESPECIALLY WHEN

card.writes: It pushes the model to predict "the" as the next word and discourages non-English words.
card.plain: It fires in capitalised warning text when the next word is likely to be "the" or "an".
